$comment: The church's layered data views (docs/reporting.md): foundations, the Ministry by Design path, next-step views filed by Ministry System, the communication flows' audiences, and Finance. Every view uses Rock's own filter components and selection strings, as group-syncs.json does. A leaf that points at another view names it by 'dataView' key, in this file or group-syncs.json or registrations.json, and the loader writes Rock's selection with that view's Id (Existing Data View filters, with Use Persisted on, as Rock's editor saves it) or Guid (related data view filters). A 'steps' leaf is Rock's Steps Taken filter: Complete steps in one program, of one step type or every type in a stage from steps.json. 'entityType' is left out for a person view. 'persisted' names a named schedule or an interval; Rock's job persists a view the first minute after install. 'transform' is Rock's post-filter transformation. A view whose part was left out of a load is skipped.

namedSchedules.name: Nightly at 2 AM
namedSchedules.description: Refreshes the persisted data views that are slow to run, once a night.

dataViews.name: Active People
dataViews.description: Everyone whose record is active. Every other church person view starts here.

dataViews.name: Adults
dataViews.description: Active people Rock classifies as adults.

dataViews.name: Children
dataViews.description: Active people Rock classifies as children.

dataViews.name: Church Family
dataViews.description: Active people who are Connected, Engaged, or Leading, the church's three most involved connection statuses. Rock's shipped Member & Attendees view checks Rock's old statuses, so it leaves out Leading.

dataViews.name: Regular Attenders
dataViews.description: Active people who came to a worship service 4 or more times in the last 12 weeks. Persisted nightly, since it counts attendance and many views build on it.

dataViews.name: Accepts Mass Email
dataViews.description: Active people with an email who accept mass email.

dataViews.name: In a Small Group
dataViews.description: Active people who are active members of an active small group, in any role.

dataViews.name: Serving
dataViews.description: Active people who are active members of an active serving team, in any role.

dataViews.name: Active Small Groups
dataViews.description: Every active small group.

dataViews.name: Active Serving Teams
dataViews.description: Every active serving team, at every campus.

dataViews.name: Involved Adults
dataViews.description: Adults who came to worship, were in a small group, served, or gave in the last 12 months. Giving uses Rock's Last Gave attribute, which Rock already shows to staff, so this view stays out of Finance.

dataViews.name: Belong Stage
dataViews.description: Active people who have taken a Belong step: the Starting Point Class, a small group, or Student Camp. Stages overlap, so a person can be in more than one.

dataViews.name: Equip Stage
dataViews.description: Active people who have taken an Equip step: baptism, Foundations, or Follow Jesus.

dataViews.name: Contribute Stage
dataViews.description: Active people who have taken a Contribute step: serving, giving, or a mission trip. It counts the Give step, which Rock already shows staff on each person's Steps tab, so it stays out of Finance.

dataViews.name: Lead Stage
dataViews.description: Active people who have taken a Lead step: leading a small group or serving team, or Student Leader.

dataViews.name: Path Steps in the Last 90 Days
dataViews.description: Active people who completed any step on either path in the last 90 days.

dataViews.name: Guests Coming Back
dataViews.description: Adults who first came to worship in the last 6 months, have come 3 or more times since, and have not taken the Starting Point Class. The next step from Notice into Belong.

dataViews.name: First Visit Last Week
dataViews.description: Adults who accept mass email and came to worship for the first time in the last 7 days. The First-Time Guest Welcome flow's audience, through its reserved email view.

dataViews.name: Ready to Belong
dataViews.description: Adults who come regularly but are not in a small group, to invite to Small Group Connect.

dataViews.name: Small Groups With Room
dataViews.description: Active small groups with fewer than 12 active members, the church's target size (configuration/small-groups.json), where a new person can join.

dataViews.name: Kids Checked In Recently
dataViews.description: Children who checked in to the Nursery/Preschool or Elementary area in the last 4 weeks. Persisted every 60 minutes, so it is fresh on a Sunday afternoon.

dataViews.name: Students Attending the Student Service
dataViews.description: Students in grades 7 to 12 who checked in to the Jr High or High School area in the last 12 weeks.

dataViews.name: Ready to Grow
dataViews.description: Adults who have taken a Belong step but no Equip step yet, to invite to Foundations or baptism.

dataViews.name: Belonging a Year, Not Yet Growing
dataViews.description: People in a small group whose Belong steps are all more than a year old, and who have no Equip step. Their group leader can offer a next step.

dataViews.name: Unbaptized Regular Attenders
dataViews.description: Adults who come regularly and have not been baptized. The Baptism Sunday Invitation flow's audience, through its reserved email view.

dataViews.name: Baptized This Year
dataViews.description: Active people whose Baptism Date is in the last 12 months, to celebrate.

dataViews.name: Ready to Serve
dataViews.description: Adults who have taken an Equip step and are not serving. Growth comes before serving, so an Equip step comes first.

dataViews.name: Ready to Lead
dataViews.description: Adults who have taken an Equip step, serve on a team, and are in a small group, but lead nothing yet. To invite to Group Leader Training.

dataViews.name: Drifting Adults
dataViews.description: Adults who came to worship 10 or more times in the last 18 months and not at all in the last 90 days.

dataViews.name: Newly Missed
dataViews.description: Drifting adults who accept mass email and came at least once in the last 120 days, so their 90 days ran out in the last month. The We Miss You flow's audience, through its reserved email view.

dataViews.name: Back in the Last 30 Days
dataViews.description: Active people who came to worship in the last 30 days. The We Miss You flow's goal.

dataViews.name: Women Who Attend
dataViews.description: Women 25 to 75 who accept mass email and came to worship in the last 12 months, to invite to the Women's Retreat.

dataViews.name: Reserved or No Email
dataViews.description: People whose email is on the reserved example.org domain, or who have none. Only the Cast staff use a real domain, so the flows send only to people in this view. A real church would not need it.

dataViews.name: First Visit Last Week, Reserved Email
dataViews.description: First Visit Last Week, with a reserved email or none. The First-Time Guest Welcome flow's audience.

dataViews.name: Newly Missed, Reserved Email
dataViews.description: Newly Missed, with a reserved email or none. The We Miss You flow's audience. The flow ships paused, but its audience keeps the guard.

dataViews.name: Unbaptized Regular Attenders, Reserved Email
dataViews.description: Unbaptized Regular Attenders, with a reserved email or none. The Baptism Sunday Invitation flow's audience.

dataViews.name: Students Not Registered for Camp, Reserved Email
dataViews.description: Students Not Registered for Camp, with a reserved email or none. The Student Camp flow's audience.

dataViews.name: Women Who Attend, Reserved Email
dataViews.description: Women Who Attend, with a reserved email or none. The Women's Retreat flow's audience.

dataViews.name: Involved Adults, Reserved Email
dataViews.description: Involved Adults, with a reserved email or none. The Christmas at Rock Solid flow's audience.

dataViews.name: Ready to Lead, Reserved Email
dataViews.description: Ready to Lead, with a reserved email or none. The Lead a Group flow's audience.

dataViews.name: Teams Requiring a Background Check
dataViews.description: Serving teams whose Requires Background Check setting is on: Kids Ministry and Student Ministry at every campus.

dataViews.name: Kids and Student Volunteers
dataViews.description: Active people who are active members, in any role, of a team that requires a background check.

dataViews.name: Kids With an Allergy
dataViews.description: Children checked in recently who have an allergy on their record. An allergy is medical information, so the list is in Safety.

dataViews.name: Gifts in the Last 12 Months
dataViews.description: Every contribution in the last 12 months.

dataViews.name: Givers in the Last 12 Months
dataViews.description: People with a contribution in the last 12 months. Persisted nightly, since it reads a year of gifts.

dataViews.name: First-Time Givers
dataViews.description: Active people whose first contribution was in the last 90 days. Its filter is one Rock locks to the finance roles.

dataViews.name: Lapsed Givers
dataViews.description: Active people Rock's giving journey shows as Lapsed Givers.

dataViews.name: Top Givers
dataViews.description: Active people in Rock's top giving bin. Only Finance Administration and Rock Administration can see it, so even Finance Workers do not see who gives the most.

dataViews.name: Event Registration Payments
dataViews.description: Every event registration payment in the last 12 months.

dataViews.name: Money Matters Invite List
dataViews.description: Church Family adults who have not given in the last 12 months, to invite to Money Matters. It builds on a Finance view, so it tells who does not give, and it is in Finance.

dataViews.name: Built on the Rock Pledges
dataViews.description: Every pledge to the Built on the Rock building campaign.

dataViews.name: Built on the Rock Pledgers
dataViews.description: The people named on a Built on the Rock pledge.

dataViews.name: Built on the Rock Pledge Households
dataViews.description: Everyone in a family where someone pledged to Built on the Rock, through Rock's Family Members transformation. A pledge names one person, so this keeps a spouse from being asked to pledge again. The Built on the Rock Follow-Up flow's goal.

dataViews.name: Involved Adults Not Yet Pledged
dataViews.description: Involved adults in a family that has not pledged to Built on the Rock. The Built on the Rock Follow-Up flow's audience.

$accessComment: The security walkthrough (docs/reporting.md section 7): for a Cast person, a category or data view key, and an action, whether Rock's own security check must allow it. Verify asks Rock each one.
